steps.npc: I say, I say, a toast to this fine human!

steps.text: Without a beer, jug of wine, or dwarven stout:

steps.player: I don't have anything suitable to toast with.

steps.npc: Then go get something from the bar!

steps.player: Well, I have this jug of wine...

steps.npc: No no, get a pint of beer, jugs of wine aren't good to toast with! Wine stains are terribly hard to wash out of a beard.

steps.text: With a beer or dwarven stout:
An animation plays when the player and Gauss clink glasses together, and the beer/stout is replaced with an empty beer glass.
